description.zh: 锚在视口角落、悬浮于内容之上的圆形按钮，承载当前页面唯一的主操作（新建、撰写、扫码）。 用阴影和位置宣告「我在所有内容之上」，比行内主按钮更醒目，但一屏只应有一个。点击后可展开 为带标签的扩展形态，或扇出一组快捷动作。
description.en: A circular button anchored to a corner of the viewport, floating above the content and carrying the one primary action of the current view (create, compose, scan). Shadow and placement declare "I sit above everything" — louder than an inline primary button, but there should be only one per screen. On click it may expand into a labeled bar or fan out into a set of quick actions.

disambiguation.zh: 悬浮按钮不是「更显眼的主按钮」：主按钮嵌在页面布局里、随内容滚动；悬浮按钮脱离文档流、 常驻视口角落并覆盖在内容之上。判断标准是它是否悬浮在滚动内容之上，而不是颜色有多亮。
disambiguation.en: A FAB is not "a louder primary button": a primary button lives inside the layout and scrolls with content; a FAB detaches from the flow, stays pinned to a corner and overlays content. The test is whether it floats above scrolling content — not how bright its color is.

use_when.zh: 页面有唯一、高频、正向的主操作（新建、撰写）
use_when.en: The view has one frequent, constructive primary action (create, compose)

use_when.zh: 底部拇指热区需要常驻入口
use_when.en: A persistent entry point in the bottom thumb zone

use_when.zh: 工具型界面需要比行内按钮更强的操作召唤
use_when.en: A tool-like surface needs a stronger call to action than an inline button

avoid_when.zh: 有多个并列主操作（并列会互相削弱，用底部操作条）
avoid_when.en: Several co-equal primary actions — they cancel out; use a bottom action bar

avoid_when.zh: 操作是破坏性的（删除、清空）
会遮挡关键内容或底部导航
avoid_when.en: It would cover key content or the bottom navigation

note.zh: 纯图标圆形按钮，最常见形态
图标 + 文字标签，行动意图更明确
note.en: Icon plus label — a clearer call to action

note.zh: 点击扇出多个子动作，再点收起
note.en: Fans out several sub-actions on click, retracts on second click

anatomy: 扩展标签 / 子动作（Label / Speed dial actions）

task.zh: 点击右下角悬浮按钮，展开子动作后再收起，观察它与内容的层级关系。
task.en: Tap the corner FAB, fan out the sub-actions and retract; watch how it layers over content.

checks.zh: 按钮悬浮于滚动内容之上且不被遮挡
checks.en: The button floats above scrolling content and stays unoccluded

checks.zh: 扇出的子动作均可键盘到达
checks.en: Every fanned-out sub-action is keyboard reachable

notes.zh: position: fixed（或 absolute 于滚动容器外）锚定角落，圆形用 border-radius: 9999px； 抬升靠 box-shadow 多层阴影而非描边。扇出的子动作用 scale + opacity 依次错开出现， 主按钮旋转 45° 变关闭。按压 scale(0.94) 反馈；触控目标不小于 48px；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Anchor the corner with position: fixed (or absolute outside the scroller); make it circular with border-radius: 9999px; elevation comes from layered box-shadows, not outlines. Speed-dial actions stagger in with scale + opacity while the main button rotates 45° into a close affordance. Press feedback is scale(0.94); keep the touch target ≥ 48px; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个悬浮按钮（FAB）组件：圆形图标按钮固定在右下角，点击扇出多个子动作。
basic.en: Create a Floating Action Button: a circular icon button pinned to the bottom-right corner that fans out several sub-actions on click.

design.zh: 创建 FAB：56px 圆形、主色填充、白色图标、多层柔和阴影；右下角距边 16px； 扩展形态为图标 + 标签胶囊；扇出子动作为 40px 小圆钮，从下往上错开浮现； 按压轻微缩小；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a FAB: a 56px circle, accent fill, white icon, layered soft shadow; 16px from the bottom-right edge; the extended form is an icon-plus-label pill; speed-dial actions are 40px mini circles staggering upward; subtle press scale; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 FAB：variant 映射 single / extended / speed-dial；open 受控， 子动作用 CSS transition 交错 delay 呈现；role="menu" 或 group 语义，aria-expanded 标在主按钮上；主按钮点击切换 open，Esc 收起并归还焦点；active:scale-[0.94] 按压反馈； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind FAB: a variant map for single / extended / speed-dial; controlled open state with staggered CSS transition delays on sub-actions; role="menu" or group semantics with aria-expanded on the main button; clicking toggles open, Esc retracts and restores focus; active:scale-[0.94] press feedback; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现一个 FAB 悬浮按钮组件。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前按钮与阴影变量。
与行内主按钮区分：悬浮、常驻、一屏一个。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Floating Action Button in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse button and shadow
variables.
Keep it distinct from an inline primary button: floating, persistent, one per screen.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.
